description: This PHP source file appears to be part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It handles viewing and managing requirements within the project, including initializing page components, processing arguments, managing access rights, and rendering the 'Requirement View' page with associated data such as requirement details, versions, attachments, and relations.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: A manager class for handling requirement data, such as retrieving requirement versions, comments, attachments, relations, and coverage information.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class managing test project data, including retrieving project information and test case prefixes.

classes.name: reqCommands
classes.description: A class for handling complex requirement-related commands and GUI initialization.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes request arguments related to requirements, including ID validation, version handling, and user session data.

methods.name: initialize_gui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI bean with requirement data, versions, attachments, and permissions, preparing it for rendering.

methods.name: getGrants
methods.description: Determines the user's rights and permissions related to requirement management for a specific test project.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has appropriate access rights for the current context.

methods.name: initTestprojectSelect
methods.description: Prepares the data for populating a test project selection dropdown.
